newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Duff & Phelps says not planning Argentina change.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps says not planning Argentina change.

text.p: Duff & Phelps is not considering any imminent change to its Argentine debt ratings, the general manager of the ratings agency's Argentine office said Wednesday.
"There is no modification foreseen," Gabriel Rubenstein told Reuters. But he also said, "I would say that at this moment (Argentina's) outlook is more positive."
Standard & Poor's said earlier Wednesday it was raising its rating on Argentina's $62.2 billion in long-term foreign currency debt to BB from BB-.

But Rubenstein said that the new Standard & Poor's rating was essentially equivalent to Duff & Phelps' BB rating on Argentina's foreign currency debt. Duff & Phelps adopted its current rating in December 1993, he said.
